title: Solomon's Dedication Prayer for the Temple
description: King Solomon dedicates the temple in Jerusalem with an extensive prayer. He praises God for fulfilling His promise to David and asks God to hear prayers directed toward the temple in various situations: during oaths and judgments, defeat in war, drought, famine, plague, when foreigners seek God, warfare, and when the people are taken into captivity. He concludes by asking God to come to His resting place and remember His covenant with David.
